summary.content:
Today's selection covers 69 articles from 7 trusted sources, including 52 on Artificial Intelligence and 10 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: The future of code is exciting and terrifying
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: LeakNet ransomware uses ClickFix, Deno runtime in stealthy attacks
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, scams
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from The Verge, BleepingComputer, BBC Technology, NY Times Tech, TechCrunch and others
• **Fresh Content**: 53 articles published in the last 24 hours
